n79e025038e.headline: Global stocks slip after US election rally, bond yields rise further, dollar climbs
n79e025038e.summary: Stocks on major world markets gave back some gains after the US election rally, while global bond yields rose for a fifth day, supporting the US dollar.
n79e025038e.why: Market reactions to political events and bond yield movements influence currency strength and risk appetite globally.
n79e025038e.why_moved: After initial post-election gains, markets corrected as bond yields rose and the dollar strengthened, leading to a pullback in global stocks.
